brand_architecture: MobileNetV3 Small, own avg/max pooled 18-brand head, regional fine-tuning, mirrored-view probability mean and development temperature
detector: General COCO Mask R-CNN visible-instance masks, instance bridge association, duplicate consolidation and person-pixel exclusion; Faster R-CNN is a fallback. Segmentation neural weights are unchanged this round.

colour: Собственные обученные цветовые головы: полная вырезка и участки кузова; веса видов выбраны по development. Готовые vehicle-colour classifiers не используются.

visual_parts.selection: Grouped validation only; mean whole/upper55/upper35 top1 + half top3, whole top1 floor baseline minus2pts. Test and city images excluded from selection.

Upper crops simulate missing body parts; they are not a real street occlusion test. Source categories and sparse Cobalt/Damas examples remain limitations.

visual_parts.calibration: NLL temperature and >=90% accepted accuracy with >=20 examples, grouped validation whole+upper55+upper35 only; geometry-quality gate is separate.

v17_scope: Own train-only part reference classifier; no pretrained vehicle-model classifier. Fragment geometry gates confirmation; full16 ranking exposed. Personal training colour head connected. Historical benchmark fields remain protocol-specific.

expanded_model_training.selection: Grouped validation only; maximize mean whole/upper55/upper35 top1+half top3, old24 clean top1 and top3 floors minus2pp. No test/city selection. Candidate only: not automatically promoted. Compare final references against v1.8 before promotion.
expanded_model_training.augmentation: Whole/upper35/upper55/left65/right65/centre details;60% isolated, flip, mild colour jitter,25% grayscale,35% random occluders. Old24 knowledge distillation from our v1.8 network. No class colour restrictions.
